title: Illumina DNA Prep Part 2, Post-Tagmentation Clean Up
author: Opentrons
materials: Post-Tagmentation Clean-Up Tagmentation Stop Buffer (TSB) is added to each sample with a multi-channel 20ul pipette, using a fresh tip each time. The multi-channel 300ul pipette is then used to mix the samples before the plate is tranferred to an off-deck thermocycler. Once the post-tagmentation thermocycler program has completed, the plate is returned to slot 2 and 'Resume' is clicked on the OT-2 application Samples are subsequently moved to a deep well plate locked onto the magnetic module in slot
Sample plate is moved to pre-prepared thermocycler
Post-thermocycler, samples in slot 2 are transferred to NEST 2ml deep well plate in slot 4 ontop of the magnetic module
Magnetic module is engaged for 3 minutes

steps.title: Add Tagmentation Stop Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL TSB from slot 1, row 1 to each sample in slot 2 using a fresh tip on the 20 µL multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Mix samples after TSB
steps.instruction: Mix each sample with the 300 µL multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Thermocycle post‑tagmentation
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate to the pre‑prepared off‑deck thermocycler, run the post‑tagmentation program, then return the plate to slot 2 and click “Resume” in the OT‑2 application.

steps.title: Transfer to magnetic deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Move the samples from slot 2 to a NEST 2 mL deep‑well plate placed on the magnetic module in slot 4.

steps.title: First magnetic capture
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Discard first supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from the wells in slot 4 into the liquid trash in slot 6.

steps.title: First TWB wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Tagmentation Wash Buffer (TWB) from slot 5, well 1 to each well, engage the magnetic module for 3 minutes, then remove the supernatant to the liquid trash in slot 6.

steps.title: Second TWB wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 100 µL TWB, 3‑minute magnetic engagement, and supernatant removal as in the previous wash.

steps.title: Third partial TWB wash
steps.instruction: Add a final 100 µL TWB from slot 5, well 1, engage the magnetic module, and proceed immediately to Part 3 as soon as possible.
